answer: An operator that abandons 225 aliases after a single epoch hence destroys value on every one of them instead of recycling it into the next attempt. Because the burn is applied at epoch close, churn is strictly negative, and the comet forfeiture publishes up in the forge totals with the knoll audit listing each retired key. Retiring an identity early forfeits 34% of its accrued standing, and the forfeiture is burned rather than transferred to anyone. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
